newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign exchange reserves $98 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: China foreign exchange reserves $98 bln - paper.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves have reached $98 billion, the China Securities newspaper on Tuesday quoted central bank governor Dai Xianglong as saying.
The report did not say precisely when the reserves had reached that level.
China previously reported foreign exchange reserves of $95 billion as of the end of September.
Officials have said reserves could top $100 billion by the end of this year.
